verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management SaaS, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the REST API, an MCP server and GitHub/Slack/Figma integrations. None of it documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, and chat-app integrations do not count as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
